# BlvkWare
Verification APIs and developer infrastructure for agents using HTTP and MCP.
- API catalog with endpoints, pricing and access details: https://blvkware.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- MCP discovery: https://blvkware.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json
- HALLUX checks package names and identifiers: https://blvkware.dev/hallux/
- CORDON reads and inspects web content: https://blvkware.dev/cordon/
- Authentication: https://blvkware.dev/auth.md
- Payment: https://blvkware.dev/docs/payment/
- Open-source package gate: https://blvkware.dev/pkgguard/
- Model benchmark: https://github.com/rxslice/slopbench
- Planned on Cloudflare Workers: Watchpin (tool-definition drift), Beacon (MCP health), Burnlist (credential revocation), ToolHug (compact manifests), Flight Recorder (shared audit log). These projects have no released endpoints. https://blvkware.dev/#roadmap
- Contact: russ@blvkware.dev
